title: British adventurer Karl Bushby completes 28-year walk around the world
description:
On November 2, Karl Bushby finished his 28-year walk back to his English hometown of Hull. Bushby spoke with NBC News about the 31,000-mile journey that first started in 1998. Raf Sanchez reports.
